verdict.rationale: Brex documents a dedicated Accounting API, Transactions/Expenses APIs, GL-coding automation, accruals, and an integrations page claiming 'all your tools synced in one place,' which together support automated sync of transactions/expenses with accounting systems. However, no named accounting-software integrations (e.g., QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero) or independent confirmation of real-world sync reliability are present. Missing for 10: specific named accounting-platform integrations, independent/hands-on verification of sync accuracy.
